sql_templates.description: Fetch latest sector breadth data with stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.name: sector_breadth
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_sector_snap AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM breadth.sector_daily),
latest_stage_snap AS (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
SELECT sd.sector, sd.pct_above_50dma, sd.change_5d, ma.stage2_pct
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN latest_sector_snap lss ON sd.snapshot_date = lss.latest_date
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
WHERE sd.snapshot_date = lss.latest_date
ORDER BY ma.stage2_pct DESC, sd.pct_above_50dma DESC
LIMIT 10;
